global_invariants: Never move a README to a script or configuration path it merely describes.
Preserve original headings, caveats, links, code, and regex escapes.
Do not invent publication dates, versions, provenance, or lifecycle fields.
Do not treat an exact name mention, shared tag, or similarity score as proof of a relationship or contradiction.
Keep all proposals pending; accept/apply is never part of this live evaluation.

review_cases.check: Consider tools/shell/README.md only when the POSIX shell and reusable-asset content supports the relation.
Do not move this overview to ci.yml, a script path, or another copied asset destination.
Any proposal preserves regexes and code spans byte-for-byte.
Keep the Community Build distinction and exact SonarQube property names.
Compare with tools/ollama.md using supplied passages; do not infer unsupported provider behavior.
Verify the supplied libraries/ruby/rspec.md target and preserve the concrete Chromium/CI caveat.
Do not generalize the coverage policy into an unrelated deletion or merge.
Do not turn documented environment-variable names into invented credentials or values.
Keep environment variables as placeholders; do not invent real tokens or deployment facts.
Treat Wappalyzer, Linguist, and NER corpora as source references to assess; do not claim they are installed or fetch them implicitly.

limitations: Live output is reviewed against these invariants, not compared as exact prose.
This selected set tests representative real notes, not full-corpus recall.
Review precision, rejected edits, stage time, and missed expected cases before expanding the set.
